item.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar says she will move after federal search of DC home
item.description: U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar says she will move out of her Washington, D.C., home that federal agents searched last week.

item.title: Idaho mother who blamed vaccines for twins' deaths faces death penalty
item.description: Andrea Shaw, 23, has said the 18-month-old twins became sick and died after receiving flu shots and routine childhood vaccinations.

item.description: Closing arguments are expected Thursday in the trial of a man accused of killing a North Carolina college student 14 years ago.
